paragraphs.text: The Forum of Amity is located in the Northeast Region of Orrithia, on the plane of Arcavios . It is a center for diplomacy founded by Shadrix Silverquill .

Composed of an opulent manor filled with salons for intimate discussions and large galleries for more formal meetings, as well as one of the largest libraries outside of the Biblioplex . Assembling diplomats, politicians, and other emissaries from across the plane, its goal is to encourage peace on Arcavios. Its employees are ambassadors appointed by their respective governments or organizations, advised by Silverquill faculty. It is a popular location for Silverquill students to observe and learn.

The Forum subsists on ritual and procedure. In its 700-year history, it has never failed to resolve a dispute. When other rituals fail, the Naming Tithe serves as a last resort. It was not invoked between c. 4515 and 4565 because of its length and tedium, but it never failed to yield a breakthrough. In the ritual, one representative from each delegation meets in the hall, from youngest to oldest, finishing with the conciliators. Each representative gives their name, descent, relation, and community, filling a basin. Then each representative takes a handful of water and names their opposite, granting them a title and obligation. In 4565, inspired by his father's poetry, Killian Lu drafted an optional addendum to the ritual that involved members of each delegation undertaking non-binding duels to emphasize shared responsibility and competitive communion.

When an attendee at the Forum feels their honor has been impugned, they may engage in a duel to gain satisfaction. To prevent disputes from being solved by force alone, Shadrix Silverquill himself composed an injunction to ban binding terms.
The Adumbral Gardens - Dotted with secretive meeting spots, wide promenades, and open arenas for dueling.
The Dragon's Podium - A large outdoor amphitheater, where Shadrix Silverquill sits when in residence. When Shadrix is not present, the space is used for larger ceremonies and occasional performances.
The Page's Common - A dedicated space for Silverquill students. The hall is filled with study tables, spaces to relax, and a raised stage for students to practice.

The Presiding Chamber - The largest internal meeting hall of the Forum of Amity. A cavernous, three-story gallery of white-and-black marble houses four great silver archways that house portals that lead across Arcavios. This space is used for discussions among all conciliators. These are often lively, and at times dangerous, with heated words and charged spells flying between participants.
